_comment: Was BANISH_OPP_TOP_GRANT_PLAY, which banishes the OPPONENT'S deck -- an unrelated effect. 'Play your next <X> this turn AS THOUGH IT WERE AN INSTANT' grants instant TIMING to one card -- it skips the action-speed restriction rather than gaining an ability. Was a SET_FLAG nothing reads. GRANT_INSTANT_TIMING queues a one-shot, matched the way the other queues match and spent when the card is actually PLAYED: the legality path asks many times per decision and must not spend a grant merely by asking. 'You may play Evos from your banished zone' is a separate, permanent permission and is declared as one.
